name: spellkave_note_doc_gap
label: Note Doc Gap
description: Record a discrepancy between what the modding docs implied and what the validator actually accepted. Does NOT end your run — keep authoring. Sharpens the docs shipped to other authors.

doc.description: Which corpus doc id you were working from, e.g. 'dsl-grammar'.

expected.description: What the doc led you to expect.

actual.description: What the validator actually did — the discrepancy.
